register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join FursadHub today

roleSelector.label: I want to join as
roleSelector.studentHint: Find internships, apply, and follow your placement. After you sign in, your university confirms your enrollment.
roleSelector.organizationHint: Publish internships and manage interns. After you sign in, you set up your organization and submit it for verification.
roleSelector.universityHint: Verify your students and oversee their internships. After you sign in, you register your university and submit it for verification.

register.acceptTermsRequired: You must accept the terms before creating an account.

errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: An account with this email already exists.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a bit and try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't create your account right now. Check your connection and try again.

register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
register.nextStep: Next, we’ll email you a 4-digit code to confirm your address.
register.staffNote: University and organization staff don’t register here — your administrator creates your account.

errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account has been suspended. Contact support for help.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a bit and try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't sign you in right now. Check your connection and try again.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: Enter the 4-digit code we sent to {{email}}
verifyEmail.resendSuccess: A new code has been sent.
verifyEmail.successBody: Your email address has been verified.
verifyEmail.missingEmailBody: We'll send you a new verification code.

errors.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID: That code is not right, or it has already been used. Check the latest email, or sign in if this address is already verified.
errors.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Request a new one below.
errors.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_LOCKED: Too many incorrect attempts. Request a new code.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a bit and try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't check that code right now. Check your connection and try again.

verifyEmail.verifyingBody: Checking your code with FursadHub. This only takes a moment.
verifyEmail.successBodyOrganization: Your email is verified. Continue setting up your organization.
verifyEmail.successBodyUniversity: Your email is verified. Continue your institution onboarding.
verifyEmail.expiredBody: Verification codes are short-lived for security. Request a new one and we will email it straight away.
verifyEmail.lockedBody: For your security this code can no longer be used. Request a new one to continue.
verifyEmail.registeredNotice: Your account has been created. Enter the code below to confirm your email address.
verifyEmail.autoHint: Enter all 4 digits — the code is checked as soon as you type the last one.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.successBody: If an account exists for this email, a password reset link has been sent.

resetPassword.title: Create new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Your new password must be different from previous used passwords.
resetPassword.successBody: Your password has been reset. Please sign in again.

errors.PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_INVALID: This reset link is invalid or has already been used.
errors.missingToken: This reset link is missing its token.
errors.generic: We couldn't reset your password right now. Check your connection and try again.

resetPassword.missingTokenBody: Password reset links carry a one-time token. Open the link from your email, or request a new one.
resetPassword.linkDeadBody: Reset links expire and can only be used once. Request a new one and we will email it straight away.

getStarted.title: Choose how you want to use FursadHub
getStarted.subtitle: Your account is ready. Choose what you are setting up first.
